pages.text: Everything this port adds beyond bug fixes can be switched off in $(l)config/brandon3055/DraconicEvolution.cfg$(), section $(l)Extras$(). Each half has a master switch called $(l)extras$(); turning it off gives the official mod's behaviour.$(br2)Bug fixes are not in this list and are always on.

pages.title: Client (your own)
pages.text: $(li)$(l)coreScreenDetails$(): In/Out/Net lines, time to full/empty, short numbers.$(li)$(l)coreGraph$(): the graph button.$(li)$(l)coreUnitToggle$(): the OP/RF button.$(li)$(l)structureHints$(): the blocks-wrong line.$(li)$(l)pylonModeColours$(): green/red pylon particles.

pages.title: Server (everyone)
pages.text: $(li)$(l)grinderXpPiping$(): liquid XP out of the Mob Grinder.$(li)$(l)guideBookRecipe$(): this book's recipe.$(li)$(l)coreRateHistory$(): cores record their graph data.$(li)$(l)pylonModeMessage$(): the pylon INPUT/OUTPUT message.$(br2)The server's choices reach your game when you join.

pages.title: Elsewhere
pages.text: $(li)Jade's own settings can turn off the Draconic Energy Core tooltips.$(li)The HD texture packs are off until you pick them in Resource Packs.$(li)The eye button and $(l)blockEffectRenderDistance$() control the core effects.
